name_zh: 哈里发·本·阿卜杜拉/巴格达哈里发：伊斯兰教法哈里发治理与帝国秩序
name_en: Caliph al-Mansur/Baghdad Caliphs: Islamic Legal Caliphate Governance & Imperial Order
description_zh: 阿布·贾法尔·阿卜杜拉·阿勒·曼苏尔 (714-775) 阿拔斯王朝第二任哈里发，建立巴格达圆城 (762)，确立"哈里发-维齐尔-迪万"三权分立雏形：哈里发掌握宗教/军事最高权、维齐尔(宰相)统领行政、迪万(部门)分司其职。核心治理技术：伊斯兰教法 (Fiqh) 立法/司法统一、巴伊特马尔(国库)财政中央化、马立克/哈乃非/沙斐仪/罕百里四大法学派共存竞争、巴伊阿(效忠誓约)政治合法性。体现 M160 伊斯兰教法/哈里发治理——以神圣法为宪法、以学者阶层为官僚体系、以效忠誓约为政治契约。
description_en: Abu Ja'far Abdullah al-Mansur (714-775), 2nd Abbasid Caliph, built Round City of Baghdad (762), established proto-separation of powers 'Caliph-Vizier-Diwan': Caliph holds supreme religious/military authority, Vizier (chief minister) heads administration, Diwan (departments) divide jurisdiction. Core governance tech: Islamic law (Fiqh) legislative/judicial unification, Bayt al-Mal (treasury) fiscal centralization, four Sunni madhhabs (Maliki/Hanafi/Shafi'i/Hanbali) coexist & compete, Bay'ah (oath of allegiance) as political legitimacy. Exemplifies M160 Islamic Legal/Caliphal Governance—divine law as constitution, scholar class as bureaucracy, oath of allegiance as political contract.
reason_zh: 阿拔斯哈里发国非神权专制，而是"教法宪法+学者官僚+效忠契约"三位一体：哈里发受教法约束、卡迪(法官)独立裁判、乌里玛制衡王权。M160 区隔于 M149 伊斯兰咨询(舒拉决策)、M161 瓦克夫慈善(资产永久化)，核心在于"教法即宪法、学者即官僚、效忠即契约"的帝国级治理操作系统。
reason_en: Abbasid Caliphate not theocratic autocracy but trinity of 'fiqh constitution + scholar bureaucracy + allegiance contract': Caliph bound by fiqh, Qadis independent adjudication, Ulama check caliphal power. M160 distinct from M149 Islamic Shura (consultative decision) and M161 Waqf Philanthropy (asset perpetuity), core: 'fiqh as constitution, scholars as bureaucracy, allegiance as contract' imperial-grade governance OS.
steps_zh: 圆城规划与象征权力：762 年巴格达圆城，几何秩序映射宇宙/教法秩序
维齐尔制行政专业化：伊斯兰历史上首创宰相制度，迪万部门化(税收/军务/邮政/司法)
教法立法与司法独立：卡迪任命/罢免权在哈里发但判决依教法不可干预，四大法学派竞争繁荣
国库中央化与币制改革：迪纳尔/迪尔汗标准化、土地税(哈拉吉)/人头税(吉兹亚)制度化
翻译运动与知识帝国：贝特·希克马(智慧院)翻译希腊/波斯/印度学术，阿拉伯语成科学通用语
steps_en: Round city planning & symbolic power: 762 Round Baghdad, geometric order mirroring cosmic/fiqh order
Vizierate administrative professionalization: Islamic history's first vizier system, Diwan departmentalization (tax/military/post/judicial)
Fiqh legislation & judicial independence: Qadi appointment/removal by Caliph but judgment per fiqh non-interferable, four madhhabs compete & flourish
Treasury centralization & currency reform: Dinar/Dirham standardization, land tax (kharaj)/poll tax (jizya) systematized
Translation movement & knowledge empire: Bayt al-Hikma (House of Wisdom) translates Greek/Persian/Indian learning, Arabic becomes scientific lingua franca
expected_zh: 早期伊斯兰帝国以"教法宪法+学者官僚+翻译运动"三位一体，实现跨族群/跨语言/跨文明的超大规模知识政治整合，治理模式延续 500 年。
expected_en: Early Islamic empire achieves trans-ethnic/trans-linguistic/trans-civilizational mega-scale knowledge-political integration via trinity of 'fiqh constitution + scholar bureaucracy + translation movement', governance model lasts 500 years.
case_zh: 762 巴格达建城→786-809 哈伦·拉希德盛世→813-833 马文·拉希德/穆阿台绥姆→945 布耶王朝实权夺取→1258 蒙古灭巴格达，哈里发制名存实亡但教法治理遗产延续至今。
case_en: 762 Baghdad founded -> 786-809 Harun al-Rashid golden age -> 813-833 Al-Ma'mun/Al-Mu'tasim -> 945 Buyids seize real power -> 1258 Mongols sack Baghdad, caliphate nominal but fiqh governance legacy continues today.
intellectual_tradition: Abbasid Fiqh Governance / Islamic Legal Theory
cross_cultural_impact: Madhhab system for Islamic law; Bayt al-Hikma translation model; Diwan administrative template for Ottoman/Mughal/Safavid
resource_curse_mitigation: Bayt al-Mal fiscal discipline; waqf endowments for public goods; agricultural tax reform
